description: After repeated truncated reads of the same URL, agent should call done with what it has and tell user the response is partial.

args.summary:
This page contains a long academic text with sections labeled **Section A** and **Section B**. The visible content is truncated, so I can only summarize what is present:

- The page begins with a title and introductory section.
- It contains multiple sections labeled **Section A** and **Section B**.
- The visible text is truncated, so the full content of the sections is not available.

For a complete summary, I would need the full text of the page.
Summary of the visible portion: [synthesis of Section A and B]. The page is large and read_page returned truncated content twice — I've summarized what I can see.

antiPatterns.reason: Third identical read won't yield more.

expected.successRubric: Deliver a summary of what is visible. Acknowledge the truncation. Don't loop.

content: The page is truncated and appears to be a long academic text with sections A and B. The page content is not fully available, so I should summarize what is visible while noting the limitation.</think>
